name: watsonx.ai LangGraph ReAct Agent
description: IBM's base agent template: a LangGraph ReAct agent with tool calling that runs locally and deploys to watsonx.ai as an AI service.
whatItDoes: It gives developers a working function-calling agent they can adapt with their own tools, test locally and deploy on IBM Cloud, including a chat app for talking to the deployment.
howItWorks: The agent is a LangGraph ReAct graph using a watsonx.ai chat model and tools defined in the template. The watsonx-ai CLI scaffolds the template, invokes it locally and creates the deployed service.

requirements.name: IBM watsonx.ai account
requirements.description: API key, project/space and URL set in the template config
